newsitem.title: CHINA: China motorcycle firms profits plunge.
newsitem.headline: China motorcycle firms profits plunge.

text.p: The profits of China's motorcycle producers are falling because of a price war caused by excess production and fierce market competition, the Business News reported on Tuesday.
National motorcycle output in the first nine months was 6.442 million units, up 15.68 percent over the same 1995 period, with sales of 5.6 million, up 9.65 percent, it said.
As a result, producers hold stocks of 676,761 units, equal to one month's national production, it said.
The newspaper forecast total 1996 motorcycle output at more than 8.5 million units, up from 6.81 million in all 1995, it said but gave no further details.
